shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Three arrows sit in the lane and map to the three top lanes. There is a switch directly under them, and a gate near the top that the action button can divert a plunged ball through when Lock is lit.

shots.name: Top Lanes
shots.notes: Three lanes across the back. Completing them raises the end-of-ball bonus multiplier, and the shooter-lane arrows decide which ones start lit.

shots.name: Left Orbit & Saucer
shots.notes: The most important shot on the machine outside of modes. A saucer at its apex holds the ball for mystery, minor villain selection, extra ball, and both wizard modes.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Where the three Villain Multiball locks live, and one of the two Riddler qualifiers.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: A Catwoman qualifier and a combo starter. Several Catwoman stages open with a hurry-up parked here.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: The other Catwoman qualifier. Joker's stage 2 shot list deliberately leaves this one out, so do not waste shots on it there.

shots.name: Turntable
shots.notes: The centrepiece. It rotates between a Batcave face and a Villain-Vision face, and rotating it far enough exposes the Bat-Phone. Several stages use its magnet, which makes the feed genuinely unpredictable.

shots.name: Bat-Phone
shots.notes: Only reachable once the turntable has rotated to show it. This is the shot that converts a qualified villain into a running mode.

shots.name: Turntable Targets
shots.notes: A standup on each side of the Batmobile spinner. Either one lights a lock during a major villain mode; both together light the Atomic Pile for playfield multiplier. Also the Joker qualifier.

shots.name: Batmobile Spinner
shots.notes: A spinning post in front of the Atomic Pile. Every spin adds 25K to the Bat Turn value, and ten spins light the mode.

shots.name: Atomic Pile
shots.notes: The lane behind the Batmobile spinner. It starts Bat Turn, collects the playfield multiplier, and is the Villain Multiball super jackpot.

shots.name: Penguin Scoop
shots.notes: Qualifies Penguin and cashes every major villain super jackpot. Balls that arrive here out of the bumpers do not count toward Penguin.

shots.name: Crane & Wrecking Ball
shots.notes: A wrecking ball on a moving crane. It parks over one of five purple inserts at a time and both Penguin modes are built around hitting it at each position.

shots.name: Commissioner Gordon Target
shots.notes: Three hits arm the shot multipliers. It also pushes the Bat-Phone hurry-up value up, which raises every mode shot you score afterwards.

shots.name: GADGET Targets
shots.notes: The standup bank on the left. Spelling GADGET banks one gadget for the action button. Several modes park hurry-ups here.

shots.name: TV Targets
shots.notes: Three standups. Completing them lights a minor villain at the left orbit, and completing them again inside a minor villain mode raises that mode's shot values.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Toggle which targets are lit during Shame, and relight jackpot shots in Batusi Multiball. A ball that reaches the scoop from here will not qualify Penguin.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: One half of the mystery pair. The return lanes cycle with the flipper buttons, so you can steer which one is unlit.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: The other return lane. Complete both to light mystery at the left orbit saucer.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: No safety net here. Losing a ball mid-mode costs the whole mode, including any super jackpot you have banked but not cashed.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Draining during the Villain Escape build phase ends that phase early — unless you have already captured Mr. Freeze.

shots.name: Action Button
shots.notes: Press it to spend a gadget, hold it for just over a second to change TV channels. It also confirms your minor villain choice and can trigger the lock diverter.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Holding it during the plunge arms the Super Skill Shot. It also feeds the right ramp, right orbit and Gordon.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the left ramp, left orbit and scoop. Held down before a mode starts, it cycles which of a villain's two modes you will play.

goals.title: Top Lane Skill Shot
goals.summary: Down in the shooter lane sit three arrows, each one paired with a top lane above. Roll the ball across the switch beneath them while they are lit and every lane whose arrow was on comes on too. Pays 600K plus 200K for each skill shot already banked this game, and hands your end-of-ball bonus another 5x.
goals.reward: 600K + 200K per skill shot, +5x bonus

steps.action: Full plunge with all three arrows lit
steps.detail: The arrows in the shooter lane cycle — time the plunge for the moment all three are on, and every lane they cover lights too. Lit top lanes feed straight into your bonus multiplier, the only thing that multiplies your combo total at the end of the ball.

goals.title: Penguin Skill Shot
goals.summary: Ease the plunge so the ball settles into the Penguin scoop from behind; if it carries on down to the flippers instead, send it back up the scoop before the window shuts. Payout runs 1M to 1.2M according to how many arrows are lit, your end-of-ball bonus gains 5x, and the shot still counts toward qualifying Penguin.
goals.reward: 1M-1.2M, +5x bonus, Penguin progress

steps.action: Feather the plunge into the scoop
steps.detail: Ease it so the ball drops into the scoop from behind — miss the catch and it rolls to the flippers instead, so answer fast and re-shoot the scoop before the window closes. More lit arrows means a bigger payout, and the shot advances whatever the scoop would normally award.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot
goals.summary: Hold the left flipper as you plunge and any flashing major shot becomes live for five seconds. Around 550K plus 100K per skill shot, and it qualifies whichever major villain that shot belongs to — or hands you a gadget instead if a villain is already running.
goals.reward: ~550K + 100K per skill shot, qualifies a villain or +1 gadget

steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Hold the left flipper through a full-strength plunge
steps.detail: Holding the flipper arms a five-second window on any flashing major shot; you need the ball down at the flippers with time to spare. Take whichever flashing shot qualifies the villain you actually want, since that choice is free here.

goals.title: Qualifying The Four Majors
goals.summary: Each of the four major villains has its own qualifier, and each one costs more shots every time you have already played that villain. You can qualify several before cashing them in, and that is usually the right move.
goals.reward: Turntable rotates to expose the Bat-Phone

steps.detail: One shot to each ramp is all it takes the first time around.
The same pair of standups that light your locks later.
A ball that drops into the scoop out of the bumpers does not count, so shoot it deliberately from a flipper.
Either orbit works; full clean orbits are also what feed your combo count.

goals.title: Bat-Phone Hurry-Up
goals.summary: Qualifying a villain rotates the turntable to reveal the Bat-Phone. The hurry-up there starts at 1.5M and climbs 250K for each extra villain you qualify first, topping out at 12M with all four ready — and that number is not just points, it raises every shot you score inside the mode that follows.
goals.reward: 1.5M base up to 12M, and a permanently richer mode

steps.action: Rotate it far enough to expose the phone
steps.detail: Repeat the villain's qualifier shot until the turntable turns.

steps.action: Pad the value before you cash it
steps.detail: Each Gordon hit bumps the hurry-up, and each bump adds 50K to every mode shot afterwards.
You collect whichever villain you qualified last, and a villain already banked will not count a second time inside the same hurry-up.

goals.title: Catwoman
goals.summary: A ramp mode. Both versions open by asking for three shots to each ramp, then move through hurry-ups and lit-shot clears. The first version runs four stages and its final stage un-lights shots as you hit them, so it will not let you farm points forever.
goals.reward: 500K+ per lit shot, banked into a super jackpot

steps.detail: Both Catwoman modes open the same way.
In the first version this lights the super jackpot and relights every major shot; in the second, shoot the turntable next.
Sweep the relit major shots first — every one adds to the super jackpot sitting in the scoop.

goals.title: Joker
goals.summary: Turntable-first. Both versions open by asking for the turntable, which lights both orbits and both ramps. The second version scores completion as a percentage — lit shots are worth 10 percent each and any switch adds 1 percent, so the bumpers genuinely help.
goals.reward: 500K+ per lit shot, banked into a super jackpot

steps.detail: This lights the orbits and ramps.
In the first version this lights every major shot plus the super jackpot.
The first version parks a hurry-up on the gadget targets, then runs a long fixed sequence that leaves the right ramp out entirely.
In the final stage lit shots relight others, so you can keep scoring indefinitely before you collect.

goals.title: Penguin
goals.summary: The crane mode. The wrecking ball parks over one of five purple inserts and you have to hit it at every position. Later stages hand the turntable magnet the ball, which is as unpredictable as it sounds — expect to lose shots to it and plan accordingly.
goals.reward: 500K+ per lit shot, banked into a super jackpot

steps.action: Hit the wrecking ball at all five spots
steps.detail: Each hit lights every major shot for bonus points and retires that crane position.
Both magnet stages belong to the first version: stage 2 wants three turntable target hits, and stage 3 wants a scoop followed by five turntable shots.
Shoot the crane, then any major shot to move it and relight it. Five collected shots light the super jackpot, and this loop does not run out.

goals.title: Riddler
goals.summary: The friendliest of the four. Shoot either orbit and it lights a batch of playfield shots — roughly five in the first version, about seven in the second. Clear them, take the super jackpot, repeat. Good mode to have running when you start Villain Multiball.
goals.reward: 500K+ per lit shot, banked into a super jackpot

steps.detail: Which orbit you take decides which batch of shots lights.
The second stage lights a slightly bigger batch off the same orbit shot.
In the final stage shots relight each other, so score as long as you dare before cashing.

goals.title: The Batcave Combo
goals.summary: The single best thing you can do at the start of any major villain mode. Shoot the scoop, then the left orbit while it glows orange — before you make any mode shot at all — and every shot in that mode is worth double its base value.
goals.reward: 2x base value on every shot for the whole mode

steps.detail: This has to happen before you score any mode shot, so resist the urge to start shooting arrows.

steps.action: Left orbit while it is orange
steps.detail: It stacks with the +1x for choosing to keep going, with playfield multipliers and with shot multipliers.

goals.title: Villain Multiball
goals.summary: Only available while a major villain mode is running. Hit a turntable target to light locks, then lock three balls at the right orbit. Jackpots start around 300K and climb 50K each; after twelve, the turntable swings to the Batcave face and the Atomic Pile lights for a super jackpot.
goals.reward: Escalating jackpots plus Atomic Pile super jackpots

steps.detail: The first multiball only needs one target hit for all three locks; later ones want a target per lock, then both targets per lock.

steps.action: Lock three at the right orbit
steps.detail: You can also lock by pressing the action button as a ball ejects from the left orbit saucer with Lock lit.
Every major shot is lit for jackpot. Mystery becomes a guaranteed add-a-ball while multiball is running.

steps.action: Cash super jackpots at the Atomic Pile
steps.detail: Twelve jackpots lights the first; each one after that costs two more shots, up to twenty.

goals.title: Gadgets
goals.summary: Spell GADGET on the left bank to bank one, then press the action button to spend it. In a mode it spots a shot for you — but it picks left-side shots first and only serves the mode on your current TV channel, so a badly aimed gadget is a wasted one.
goals.reward: One spotted mode shot per gadget

steps.detail: Each completion banks one gadget.
A press spends the gadget; a hold of about a second changes channels instead.

steps.action: Use one as a free lock
steps.detail: With Lock lit, time your button press to the moment the left orbit saucer kicks the ball out, and the diverter grabs it. The same trick works off the shooter lane gate after a plunge.

goals.title: Minor Villains
goals.summary: Complete the three TV targets and the left orbit lights for a minor villain. There are fourteen of them across three seasons, each 45 seconds long, and each one you finish hands you a perk that lasts the rest of the ball. This is the half of the game most players ignore.
goals.reward: A lasting perk per completed villain

steps.detail: Completing them again during a minor villain mode raises that mode's shot values.

steps.action: Shoot the left orbit to open the menu
steps.detail: Choose with the flipper buttons, confirm with the action button.

steps.action: Pick with the perk in mind
steps.detail: Playing every villain in a season makes that season available again, and one completed villain per season unlocks the minor wizard modes.

goals.title: Which Minor Villains To Chase
goals.summary: The perks are not equal, and picking well changes the shape of your whole ball. Two of them are worth going out of your way for, and one of those two is arguably the strongest single award on the machine.
goals.reward: Game-altering perks
instructions: Mr. Freeze freezes every timer in the game — the Bat-Phone hurry-up, other minor villains, playfield multipliers, Bat Turn, and the Villain Escape build phase. Take it whenever it is offered.
Bookworm makes minor villain awards last the rest of the game instead of the rest of the ball, so it is worth taking early.
Shame adds a ball to every multiball and ten seconds to the multiball ball save. It is the only minor villain that starts as a multiball on its first play.
King Tut saves your minor villain progress, and every King Tut after the first adds 1x to your main channel multiplier for the ball.
Mad Hatter lets you replay minor villains you failed, and if you win both Mad Hatter modes you can replay ones you already completed too.
Egghead banks its frenzy total into your end-of-ball bonus, and multiple Egghead wins add together.
Gadgets do not rescue every mode: the second Mad Hatter and both season 3 Eggheads ignore them completely.

goals.title: Bat Turn
goals.summary: Spin the Batmobile ten times to light Bat Turn at the Atomic Pile. Each spin adds 25K to a value that starts at 500K, so build before you start. Once running, every major shot pays the current hurry-up and goes dark; hitting the spinner relights them all and resets the value upward.
goals.reward: 40 seconds of hurry-up shots, 250K minimum each

steps.detail: Ten spins lights the mode; each later start needs two more, up to twenty.
A blue insert at the turntable tells you it is lit.
Each pass through the spinner relights every shot and pushes the value back up. If the turntable is on its Villain-Vision face the value freezes and every lit shot pays double.

goals.title: Playfield Multiplier
goals.summary: Complete both standups flanking the Batmobile spinner and the Atomic Pile lights for 2x playfield scoring for 30 seconds. Do it again while the multiplier is still running and you get 3x with a fresh timer. Capture Mr. Freeze first and that 3x can survive the entire ball.
goals.reward: 2x, then 3x playfield for 30 seconds

steps.detail: One target alone does nothing for the multiplier — you need the pair.
Thirty seconds of 2x on everything.
Re-completing the targets and shooting the pile again while it runs resets the clock and raises the multiplier.

goals.title: Shot Multipliers
goals.summary: Three hits to the Commissioner Gordon target arm the white X inserts. The very next shot you make keeps that multiplier for the rest of the ball. Your first is 2x, then 3x, up to 6x for the fifth — so aim them at the shots your current villain actually asks for.
goals.reward: Up to 6x locked onto a shot for the ball

steps.detail: Each further multiplier costs one more Gordon hit, up to seven for the 6x.
Whichever shot you make next carries the multiplier for the rest of the ball, so pick a mode shot, not a stray.
While the multipliers are already lit, hitting Gordon does nothing at all.

goals.title: The Gordon Opener
goals.summary: A small habit with a real payoff. Hit Commissioner Gordon twice at the very start of a major villain mode, before you take a single mode shot, and you bank 2x bonus plus a permanent extra multiplier on Villain Multiball scoring.
goals.reward: +2x bonus and +1x Villain Multiball scoring

steps.detail: The window opens the moment the mode does.

steps.action: Two hits before any mode shot
steps.detail: If you collect the multiplier but never start Villain Multiball in that mode, doing it again next mode stacks another 1x on top.

goals.title: Mystery
goals.summary: Complete both return lanes and the left orbit saucer lights for a mystery award. The lanes cycle with the flipper buttons, so this is almost free. What it gives depends entirely on what is running — and during any multiball it is always an add-a-ball.
goals.reward: Context-sensitive, up to 5M or an extra ball

steps.action: Cycle the lanes with the flippers
steps.detail: You steer which return lane is unlit, so complete the pair on the way back from any shot.
Awards range from bonus multipliers and gadgets through 5M, extra ball, locks, playfield multiplier and extra mode time.

goals.title: Combos
goals.summary: Any ramp or full orbit arms the major shots for a combo. Cross the playfield with your next shot and that link pays 125K, and so does every shot you keep chaining onto it. Each combo is worth another 250K in end-of-ball bonus too, which is where they quietly add up.
goals.reward: 125K per combo shot, 250K each in bonus, extra balls at 20/50/100

steps.action: Start with a ramp or a clean orbit
steps.detail: Anything short of a full orbit will not arm the combo.
Each additional link is worth another 125K.
Twenty, fifty and one hundred combos in a game each light the left orbit saucer for extra ball.

goals.title: Changing Channels
goals.summary: Modes here do not queue — they all run at once, and the display only shows the most recent one. Keep the action button pressed for a beat past a second and a different mode takes over the main channel, a choice with real scoring consequences most players never discover.
goals.reward: Directs gadgets and the main channel multiplier
instructions: Four things share the channel system: major villain modes, minor villain modes, Villain Multiball and Bat Turn. Starting one does not pause the others.
A long press past the one-second mark swaps channels; a quick tap spends a gadget instead.
The main channel multiplier you earn from King Tut only applies to whatever is on the main channel, so park your biggest mode there before you cash anything.
Gadgets spot a shot in the mode on the main channel, so switch first if a gadget is about to solve the wrong mode.
Holding the right flipper before a major villain mode starts toggles which of that villain's two modes you will play.

goals.title: Minor Villain Wizard Modes
goals.summary: Capture one minor villain from each of the three seasons and the next left orbit shot opens a menu of three six-ball multiballs. All three are chaotic and all three add balls on super jackpots, but they light those jackpots in completely different ways.
goals.reward: A six-ball multiball of your choice

steps.detail: Three seasons, one completed minor villain each.
Batusi relights its shots with pop bumper hits; Robin's Holy lights two jackpot shots at a time and cashes at the turntable; Gas Attack parks a big hurry-up on the turntable itself.

steps.action: Know the cost of each round
steps.detail: Each super jackpot adds a ball the first three times, then asks for one more shot than the last, and Batusi also raises the number of pop hits needed to relight shots.

goals.title: Villain Escape
goals.summary: The game's real ending. Capture all four major villains and the next left orbit saucer starts it. Thirty seconds of pure switch-hitting builds the jackpot value at 10K a hit, then a four-ball multiball asks you to defeat all four villains again for a super jackpot.
goals.reward: A four-ball frenzy with a jackpot you built yourself

steps.detail: If the saucer is also lit for a minor villain, that villain comes into the wizard mode with you.
Every switch adds 10K to the Villain Value. The phase ends after 30 seconds or when you drain — unless you captured Mr. Freeze, in which case only the drain ends it.
The turntable stays on its Batcave face throughout the build phase, so this is a free chance to arm Bat Turn or a playfield multiplier.
Clear every lit shot — for Penguin, all five crane spots and then the scoop — and the super jackpot lights at the saucer. It adds a ball the first three times.

goals.title: End-Of-Ball Bonus
goals.summary: Bonus is built from your per-shot value in each of the four villains plus 250K for every combo, all multiplied by your bonus multiplier. Skill shots and completed lane sets are what raise that multiplier, which is why the top lanes matter more than they look.
goals.reward: A multiplied payout at the end of every ball

steps.detail: Both the top set and the return lanes advance the multiplier.

steps.action: Take the skill shot every ball
steps.detail: Each skill shot is 5x on its own, which is the cheapest multiplier in the game.
Any Egghead frenzy you won this ball is added on top and is not multiplied. Complete Bookworm and that addition repeats every ball.

achievements.title: Three Arrows Lit
achievements.desc: Catch the top lane skill shot with all three shooter-lane arrows lit.

achievements.title: Answer The Phone
achievements.desc: Rotate the turntable and cash a Bat-Phone hurry-up to start a major villain mode.

achievements.title: Both Return Lanes
achievements.desc: Complete the return lanes and collect a mystery award at the left orbit saucer.

achievements.title: Riddle Solved
achievements.desc: Cash a Riddler super jackpot at the scoop.

achievements.title: Three In The Orbit
achievements.desc: Lock three balls at the right orbit and start Villain Multiball.

achievements.title: Ten Spins
achievements.desc: Spin the Batmobile ten times and start Bat Turn at the Atomic Pile.

achievements.title: All Timers Stopped
achievements.desc: Capture Mr. Freeze and play a ball with every timer frozen.

achievements.title: Batcave Combo
achievements.desc: Shoot the scoop then the orange left orbit before scoring any mode shot.

achievements.title: Six Times
achievements.desc: Work the Commissioner Gordon target up to a 6x shot multiplier.

achievements.title: Five Wrecking Balls
achievements.desc: Hit the crane at all five of its playfield positions in one Penguin stage.

achievements.title: Twenty Combos
achievements.desc: Reach twenty combos in a game to light the extra ball.

achievements.title: One From Each Season
achievements.desc: Capture a minor villain from all three seasons and start a six-ball wizard multiball.

achievements.title: Villain Escape
achievements.desc: Arrest all four major villains and start the wizard mode at the left orbit saucer.

achievements.title: Caught Them All Again
achievements.desc: Defeat all four villains inside Villain Escape and collect the super jackpot.

drills.title: All Three Skill Shots
drills.text: Run the three of them back to back: the full plunge timed so all three shooter-lane arrows are lit and their top lanes come on with them, the feathered plunge that settles into the Penguin scoop, and the held left flipper that arms a flashing major shot. Every one is another 5x on your bonus multiplier, which is the cheapest multiplier on the machine.

drills.title: Both Ramps, Alternating
drills.text: Alternate left ramp and right ramp without a miss in between. Catwoman opens with three to each one and both ramps arm combos, so a player who can only make one side is playing half the mode.

drills.title: Gordon Before Anything Else
drills.text: The moment a major villain mode starts, put two hits on Commissioner Gordon before you take a single mode shot. Drill the shot cold from a left-flipper cradle so the habit survives the noise of a mode starting.

drills.title: Batcave Combo Reps
drills.text: Scoop, then left orbit while it glows orange, with no mode shot in between. Doubling every base value in the mode is worth more than any two shots you could have taken instead, so the discipline is not shooting the arrows first.

drills.title: Cross-Playfield Combo Chains
drills.text: Start with a ramp or a full clean orbit, then cross the playfield with the next shot and keep crossing. Anything short of a full orbit will not arm the chain, so shots that rattle back out of the orbit are the ones to count.

drills.title: Turntable Magnet Recovery
drills.text: Spend a Penguin run doing nothing but reading the magnet: shoot the turntable, then watch where the ball is thrown and get the flipper under it. Expect to lose shots up there, and plan the stage around recovering rather than around a clean feed.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: This button carries more weight than on most Stern games, because Batman 66 runs every mode you start at the same time and only one of them owns the display. A quick tap spends a banked gadget; a hold of just over a second changes which mode is on the main channel. It also confirms menu picks and can steal you a free ball lock.

uses.when: Gadget banked with a mode running
uses.what: A tap spends it and spots a mode shot — it favours left-side shots and only serves the mode on the main channel.
Hold past one second to swap the main channel, which is also the only channel your King Tut multiplier pays on.
Cycle the choices with the flipper buttons, then press to confirm the villain you want.

uses.when: Lock lit, ball in the left orbit saucer
uses.what: Press exactly as the saucer kicks out and the diverter grabs the ball for a free lock. Costs one gadget.

uses.when: Lock lit, just after a plunge
uses.what: Press once the ball trips the gate switch near the top of the shooter lane and it diverts straight into the lock.

howItPlays.objective: Play the campy 1960s TV Batman: qualify each of the four major villains at their own shots, answer the Bat-Phone to start their modes, and run them all at once across the channel system. Arrest every major villain to reach Villain Escape, the game's true ending.
loop: Qualify a villain at its shots -- send both ramps for Catwoman, the Villain-Vision standups for Joker, the scoop for Penguin and an orbit for Riddler -- to spin the turntable and expose the Bat-Phone.
Cash the Bat-Phone hurry-up to start that mode, and bank several villains first since each one lifts the hurry-up and every mode shot after it.
Open a major mode with the Batcave combo -- scoop, then the orange left orbit before any mode shot -- to double every shot for the whole mode.
Hit a Villain-Vision target to light the locks, stack three at the right orbit, and run Villain Multiball on top of the mode.
Capture all four majors to light Villain Escape at the left orbit saucer.

lights.name: Villain Qualifiers and Bat-Phone
lights.lit: Each major villain has its own qualifier shot, and a flashing insert shows one is ready; a qualified villain stays banked, so you can stack several before cashing any.
lights.flashing: A flashing qualifier means that villain is ready to convert at the Bat-Phone.
lights.then: Finishing a qualifier spins the center turntable until the Bat-Phone shows. Shoot the phone to cash a hurry-up and begin the mode -- the more villains you have banked first, the larger that hurry-up and the richer every shot inside the mode.

lights.name: Villain Multiball Locks
lights.lit: Only while a major mode runs, a Villain-Vision target hit lights the locks and the glowing right orbit swallows each locked ball.

control.effect: with Lock lit, press the button the instant the left orbit saucer kicks a ball out and the diverter steals it for a free lock -- the same press catches a plunged ball at the shooter-lane gate

lights.then: Stack three balls to start Villain Multiball with every major shot lit for jackpots. Bank a dozen and the turntable turns to its Batcave face, lighting the Atomic Pile for a super jackpot.

lights.name: Return Lane Mystery
lights.lit: A lit return lane is one you have already rolled, while the unlit one is the half of the pair you still owe.

control.effect: a tap of either flipper button slides which return lane is unlit, so you can steer the ball coming back down into the one you still need rather than the one already done
control.when: any time the ball is heading back to the flippers

lights.then: Roll both inlanes to arm Mystery, then collect it at the left orbit saucer. What it pays turns on whatever is running -- as much as five million or an extra ball, and always an add-a-ball during any multiball.

lights.name: Bonus X Top Lanes
lights.lit: The three lanes across the back feed your end-of-ball bonus multiplier, and which of them begin lit on a plunge is set by the arrows down in the shooter lane.
lights.then: Finish the set to step the multiplier that scales everything your combos are worth when the ball ends. Time a skill-shot plunge with all three arrows lit and you can close the lanes out in one go.

lights.name: Bat Turn
lights.lit: Each Batmobile spin pushes the Bat Turn value up and, once you have spun it enough, lights a blue insert at the turntable.
lights.then: Start it behind the spinner at the Atomic Pile for a run of hurry-up shots, and every pass back through the spinner relights the shots and lifts the value. Catch the turntable on its Villain-Vision face and the value freezes while every lit shot pays double.

lights.name: Commissioner Gordon Shot X
lights.lit: Land three Commissioner Gordon hits to arm the white X inserts, and the very next shot you make locks that multiplier in until the ball drains.
lights.then: Point each armed multiplier at a shot your running villain actually wants, climbing from double up toward six times. While the inserts are already lit more Gordon hits do nothing, so spend before you rearm.

lights.name: Atomic Pile Playfield X
lights.lit: The Atomic Pile lights for a playfield multiplier once you clear the pair of standups on either side of the Batmobile spinner.
lights.then: Take it behind the spinner for a stretch of doubled scoring, then re-clear the targets and shoot the pile again while it runs to reach triple. Capture Mr. Freeze first and that multiplier can ride the entire ball.

lights.name: Minor Villains
lights.lit: Finish the trio of TV targets and a minor villain lights over at the left orbit, and clearing them again inside one of those modes lifts its shot values.

control.effect: at the menu, cycle the villain choices with the flipper buttons and lock in your pick with the action button
control.when: the minor villain menu is open at the left orbit

lights.then: Each minor villain you beat hands you a perk for the rest of the ball -- freeze every timer with Mr. Freeze, or make awards last all game with Bookworm. Capture one from each of the three seasons to open a six-ball wizard multiball.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper button to swap which return lane is unlit, then guide the ball coming down through the one you still need. Completing both inlanes arms Mystery -- collected at the left orbit saucer, worth up to five million or an extra ball, and a guaranteed add-a-ball in any multiball.

scoring.text: Take a skill shot on every plunge, since each one is a cheap five-times boost to your bonus, and close the top lanes and cycled return lanes to build that multiplier further. Qualify a villain, answer the Bat-Phone, and put two Gordon hits on the board before your first mode shot.

Open each major mode with the Batcave combo to double it, then stack Villain Multiball on top by locking three at the right orbit. Arm the playfield and shot multipliers onto the shots the running villain needs, and work the overlooked minor villains for game-long perks.

Arrest all four major villains to start Villain Escape at the left orbit saucer -- thirty seconds of switch-hitting builds a jackpot you then defend across a four-ball frenzy. Capturing one minor villain from each season instead opens a six-ball wizard multiball of your choosing.
